system: Yakıt & Hava Ölçümü (MAF, MAP, O2, ECT Sensörleri)
symptoms: A properly functioning O2 sensor heater is important for reducing emissions and ensuring the engine runs efficiently.
When this circuit malfunctions, it can lead to poor fuel economy and increased emissions.
